seo.metaTitle: Who We Work With | White-Label Digital Services for Service Providers | Hostopia
seo.metaDescription: Telcos, cablecos, ISPs, mobile carriers, registrars, resellers, and MSPs use Hostopia's white-label digital services to turn their SMB base into recurring revenue — your brand, your pricing, our platform.

hero.headline: Bundles Drive Growth. The Right Ones Multiply It.
hero.subheadline: You already own the SMB relationship — the opportunity is to expand it. Across telecom, cable, broadband, mobile, domains, and IT services, the pattern is the same: core revenue is flattening while SMBs spend more than ever on digital tools — just not with you. Hostopia closes that gap with a fully white-label portfolio of digital services you can launch in weeks, not years — under your brand, with your pricing.

sections.headline: Your network reaches every small business. Your revenue shouldn't stop at connectivity.
sections.body:
Growth in core telecom revenue is slowing, ARPU is under pressure, and churn remains high. The path forward isn't more infrastructure — it's monetizing the customers you already serve.

Hostopia enables telcos to layer digital services onto connectivity:

- Business email, websites, ecommerce, SEO, listings, and reputation management
- Delivered through one platform, fully white-labeled
- Packaged into tiered bundles that grow over time

Start with a simple activation bundle (domain, email, SSL), then expand into higher-value tiers.

sections.headline: Video is declining. Broadband is commoditizing. Your advantage is local trust.
sections.body:
Cable is being squeezed from both sides — streaming on one end, fiber and fixed wireless on the other. But no national platform can replicate your local presence.

Hostopia helps you turn that into revenue:

- AI-built websites for local businesses in minutes
- Listings and directory distribution across major platforms
- Automated review and reputation tools

Bundle these with business internet to create stickier, higher-value relationships.

sections.headline: Broadband gets you in the door. Digital services keep you there.
sections.body:
When every provider claims the same speed, differentiation shifts to ownership of the customer relationship.

Hostopia increases switching costs by expanding your footprint:

- Email, websites, listings, and SEO layered onto broadband
- A single-service relationship becomes a multi-product ecosystem
- Leaving means rebuilding their entire digital presence

Start at activation with a digital starter kit, then expand over time.

sections.headline: Your customers run their business on their phone. Help them run it online.
sections.body:
5G created capacity — but monetization requires new services.

Hostopia is built for mobile-native SMBs:

- Domain, email, and AI-generated website in minutes
- Fully integrated into mobile activation flows
- Managed directly from a phone

Every new line becomes a growth opportunity.

stats.label: To launch a full digital presence

sections.headline: You own the first click. The value comes from everything after.
sections.body:
Domains are commoditized. Growth comes from what you attach.

Hostopia plugs directly into your checkout flow:

- Email attaches at the moment of domain registration
- AI-built websites follow immediately
- SEO, listings, and ecommerce expand over time

This creates a clear revenue progression:

- Year 1: domain + email + site
- Year 2: listings, security, expansion
- Year 3: SEO, reputation, ecommerce

sections.headline: Shift from transactions to recurring revenue — without building a platform.
sections.body:
The channel is moving to subscription models, but most partners lack the infrastructure to deliver at scale.

Hostopia fills that gap:

- 14+ white-label products ready to sell
- One platform for provisioning, billing, and support
- You own the customer relationship and pricing

This is not affiliate revenue — you are the provider.

sections.headline: You manage their IT. You should own their digital presence too.
sections.body:
Today, most MSPs stop at infrastructure — while websites, SEO, and digital presence go elsewhere.

Hostopia lets you extend into that layer:

- Website builder, SEO tools, listings, ecommerce
- Fully productized and ready to sell
- Delivered as recurring services

Every missed 'can you help with our website?' becomes revenue.

cta.headline: Whatever You Sell Today, There's a Bigger Relationship Behind It.
cta.body: The model is simple: launch white-label digital services, bundle them intelligently, and expand revenue per customer over time.
